events.description: CIA Senior Executive Intelligence Brief warns that Bin Ladin attacks may be imminent. US facilities are warned and are heightening security, which could delay an attack.
An Arabic news channel reported on a Monday that Bin Ladin had gone into hiding in Afghanistan because he feared a US airstrike.
CIA issues a Senior Executive Intelligence Brief warning that Bin Ladin attacks may be imminent; US facilities have been warned and are heightening security, which could delay an attack.
An Arabic news channel reports that Bin Ladin had gone into hiding in Afghanistan for fear of a US airstrike (reported on the Monday before the 23 June brief).

key_claims: Bin Ladin attacks may be imminent as of 23 June 2001.
An Arabic news channel reported Bin Ladin had gone into hiding in Afghanistan for fear of a US airstrike.
The attack timeframe may be flexible.
US facilities have been warned and are heightening security, which could delay an attack because operatives would need to revise their plans.
